article_notes: Private-clinic case series of 145 dogs with B. canis (smear) in Tyumen, 2012-2016; 13 died. Age, sex and breed are analysed against morbidity (frequency of cases), not against severity or death. Laboratory values are ranges for the whole cohort and correlations between red cell variables. Nothing tested against severity or outcome; no healthy control group. Text is an LLM translation from Russian.
